name: cld
description: Full-surface Claude Code integration for Codex: delegate, review, fan out, resume, and act on structured Claude results. Codex drives claude directly — no middleman runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks, reviews, and parallel fleets to Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Turns Codex into an orchestrator for Anthropic's Claude Code CLI. Delegate implementation or research tasks, run schema-backed code reviews, fan out parallel Claude workers, resume and fork Claude sessions, and act on structured JSON results — all through a context-safe bundled runner. The inverse of the cdx plugin (which lets Claude drive Codex).
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion from Claude on this diff
Delegate this implementation to Claude, then review its work
